It sets itself apart from [Pre-integrated Volume Rendering](5327-pre-integrated-volume-rendering.md) by mapping pairs of scalar density values directly to pre-integrated color and opacity, decoupling the integration of the transfer function from the sampling process [S3, unofficial].

The claim states that the technique (Pre-integrated Volume Rendering) maps pairs of scalar density values to pre-integrated color and opacity, and decouples the integration of the transfer function from the sampling process. Source [S3] explicitly states that 'A pré-integração desvincula a integração da contribuição da função de transferência do processo de amostragem' (Pre-integration decouples the integration of the transfer function's contribution from the sampling process). It also describes the method as pre-integrating the transfer function's contribution along ray segments to smooth imperfections, which implies the mapping of density values (scalar) to color and opacity (pre-integrated) to handle the integration separately from the sampling/reconstruction phase.
